mapper.insert: insert into user_error_types ( user_id, error_type_id, learning_mode, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{errorTypeId}, #{learningMode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id, error_type_id, learning_mode, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at from user_error_types where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select id, user_id, error_type_id, learning_mode, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at from user_error_types where user_id = #{userId} and error_type_id = #{errorTypeId} and learning_mode = #{learningMode} and name = #{name} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select uet.id, uet.error_type_id, uet.learning_mode, et.code as error_type_code, case when #{learningMode} = 'EN_TO_JA' then et.name_en else et.name end as error_type_name, uet.name, uet.description, uet.status, uet.created_at, uet.updated_at from user_error_types uet inner join error_types et on et.id = uet.error_type_id where uet.user_id = #{userId} and uet.status = #{status} and uet.learning_mode = #{learningMode} order by uet.updated_at desc, uet.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
